text:
Aminah: Heads-up — opening a small PR to consolidate the compact JSON caller patterns into the snippets landing page. Looking for a quick pass on SDK examples + link anchors when you have a moment. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :wave:
Sam K: Thanks — pinged. Which snippets are moving where?
Aminah: Mostly the compact envelope + caller examples (previously scattered). Also adding a short migration note for teams using older tool-calling shapes.
Joel: Can you include both the legacy `tool_call` and the new `function_call` examples side-by-side? I want a clear diff for folks migrating.
Aminah: Good call. I'll add a small table and a one-liner migration recipe.
Linda: I'll run the docs snippet smoke tests after you push. FYI I saw one flaky example previously with nullable arrays — might need an explicit cast in the TypeScript sample.
docs-bot: PR #842 created by Aminah in docs — CI queued. (auto)
Sam K: Re: TS example — I can patch the SDK snippet to use the typed `invokeTool()` wrapper instead of the raw `fetch`. Less copy/paste for users.
Aminah: That would be great, Sam. Also need someone to sanity-check the anchor IDs; I'm reusing older anchors and some redirect links 404.
Joel: I can do the anchor redirects. Probably safer to add a short redirect table in the markdown so old blog links still work.
Linda: Ran the snippet linter locally: two failures — one is the nullable-array example (Sam's fix should help), the other is a missing caption on a code block.
Sam K: Pushed a TS snippet update branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/843 — replaces raw call with `invokeTool()` + includes a typed response interface.
Aminah: Nice. Can you paste the small change here so I can include it in the docs diff?
Sam K: Sure — small snippet: `const resp = await client.invokeTool('reranker', {query, candidates}); // resp.items: string[] | null` then `const items = resp.items ?? []` — this avoids null assertion in examples.
Joel: For the migration note, propose this text: "If your code expects `tool_call` JSON, update to `function_call` by mapping `tool.name` -> `function.name` and move `tool.arguments` into typed params; include fallback to legacy parsing for 30 days." Thoughts?
Aminah: That wording is perfect. I'll include it and a tiny code shim example.
Linda: After Sam's patch I re-ran snippet tests — one remaining failure: the anchor link to `#caller-patterns-compact` still 404s because the heading was auto-tokenized differently by the renderer.
Aminah: Ugh. Joel, when you add the redirect table can you add a short note to update the table if headings change in future?
Joel: Yep — adding redirects now. Also adding a tiny test to the docs CI that validates internal anchor targets exist (simple grep). If the anchor doesn't exist CI will fail with a helpful message.
Sam K: Love the anchor test. That should prevent broken links from sneaking back in.
Aminah: OK — next steps: Sam merges snippet TS fix, Joel opens redirect/microtest PR, I update the migration text and push final markdown. Linda will run final smoke tests and confirm.
Linda: On it. Expect smoke test results in ~15m.
docs-bot: CI for PR #843 passed — snippet tests OK. (auto)
Linda: Verified — all snippets green after Sam's change. Anchor test added in Joel's branch will be great to keep.
Aminah: Huge thanks y'all. Once Joel's redirects are merged I'll update the table of contents and merge #842. :tada:
Sam K: :thumbsup:
Joel: Will open the redirect PR in 10m.
Linda: ack.
